# A module the bundler cannot inline still evaluates: node's own built-ins are
# left as imports for node to satisfy, so a function reaching for one gets the
# real thing rather than a bundled copy of nothing.
[!node] skip
env SNGL_CONSTEVAL_CACHE=$WORK/evalcache

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

grep 'a/b/c.txt' out/index.html
! grep 'node:path' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import lib "js:./lib"
import app "sngl:app"

const p = lib.joined()

component main ui {
    text(value=p)
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- lib/index.ts --
import { join } from "node:path";

/** @sngl-pure */
export function joined(): string {
    return join("a", "b", "c.txt");
}
